business_problem: InMobi needed to replace an expensive multicloud data warehouse because rising data volumes, siloed teams, and limited openness were hurting reporting performance and product agility.
solution_summary: InMobi uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and MLflow to support mobile advertising analytics and personalization. InMobi needed to replace an expensive multicloud data warehouse because rising data volumes, siloed teams, and limited openness were hurting reporting performance and product agility. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Customer, product, and interaction data are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL. The case study reports Driving meaningful connections between customers and brands 32%, Lower TCO compared to their multicloud data warehouse 15%, and Faster queries compared to their multicloud data warehouse 20%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: InMobi reported Driving meaningful connections between customers and brands 32%, Lower TCO compared to their multicloud data warehouse 15%, and Faster queries compared to their multicloud data warehouse 20%, improving mobile advertising analytics and personalization with measurable gains in cost reduction, productivity improvement, customer experience, and speed to market.

architecture_clues: Uses serverless or elastic compute so capacity can scale up and down with workload demand.
Centralized governance and lineage are enforced through Unity Catalog.
